get.summary: A page of the Dives of the Divers the signed-in User manages (newest first unless sorted otherwise)

parameters.name: diverId
parameters.description: Only this Diver's Dives

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Only Dives at this Dive site

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A dive number, or words from the notes or the site name

parameters.name: only
parameters.description: Comma-separated "show only" filters, all of which must fit: no-recording (a logbook entry without a Recording), no-site, with-findings (the list’s mark is set), not-at-provider (a Provider the User is connected to for the Diver has no current dive for it), changed-since-sent (at a Provider the User is connected to for the Diver, the current dive there is not up to date with the Dive, or its number differs and the Connection follows numbers)

utcOffsetSource.description: unknown: startsAt is the local wall-clock time kept as if UTC; show it in UTC without an offset (ADR 0030)

findings.description: How many findings of the dive assessment differ from guidance (note or caution) and were not put aside (ADR 0036); 0: no mark

recordings.description: How many Recordings the Dive has; 0: a logbook entry only (from a Provider or typed)

anyOf.description: The Provider whose logbook entry the Dive was made from, while it has no Recording (ADR 0030)

gases.description: The mixes the Primary recording’s computer knew; O₂ and He as percent

anyOf.description: The computer’s own surface interval before the dive

participants.description: The Divers on the Dive besides its own Diver: buddies first, then guides and instructors, each by name (ADR 0028)

state.description: waiting: goes out at `dueAt`; held: needs the User; stopped: failed for good (Retry)

anyOf.description: Why it is held (sign_in, requirements, exists, removes_verification) or the problem code of why it stopped

dueAt.description: When it goes out, for a waiting entry

waiting.description: The Dive's entries in the queue of Waiting pushes, one per Provider (ADR 0056): a small icon for waiting, a warning for held, an error with Retry for stopped (docs/spec/clients.md)

depthsM.description: Depth in metres, evenly spread over `spanSeconds`; the deepest sample of each stretch

spanSeconds.description: Seconds from the first to the last depth sample of the Primary recording

ascentBands.description: Stretches of the ascent that were fast, [start s, end s, band 1–3 for brisk, quick, very quick], in seconds from the first sample (ADR 0036)

anyOf.description: The Primary recording’s depth, reduced to draw a sketch of the dive (ADR 0041); null without a Recording or while the Dive waits to be assessed

counts.description: How many Dives each filter would show for the Diver and the search, whatever filters are applied (ADR 0040)

totals.description: The Diver’s whole logbook, not narrowed by search, site or filters

months.description: Only while sorted by date: the months of this page in page order, each with all the matching Dives of that month

get.summary: The Dives before and after one in the logbook list’s order (ADR 0042)
get.description: Takes the list’s own settings (diverId, siteId, q, only, sort, order; not limit or offset). `previous` is the row above in that list, `next` the row below. When the list does not show the Dive, `position` and both neighbours are empty.

delete.summary: Delete a Dive: it leaves the logbook, its counts and search; re-imports skip it; it can be restored
delete.description: Send the version you started from (409 dive_changed). When the Dive is at Providers, `alsoAt` names those to delete it at first (SSI's app can't bring it back). The others keep it, and the deleted Dive keeps reminding (`stillAt` in GET /dives/deleted). ADR 0026, 0027.

get.summary: The Dives of the same Diver this one may be merged with
get.description: By default those it breaks a logbook check with (ADR 0038): at the same time as an import matches a Recording to a Dive (5 minutes of tolerance; local times where a time zone is unknown), or the same dive typed with another start. `scope=nearby` lists every Dive of the Diver from the local day before to the day after, in order of their start, each with its rule or null: the Dives to choose from when the User merges two by hand.

get.summary: Logbook checks: pairs of Dives in the User's logbooks that can't both be right as they stand, and Dives that are probably no dive
get.description: Computed from the logbook each time by fixed rules (ADR 0038): a Dive without a Recording beside a Dive with one (at the same time, or on the same day with the same depth and duration), or two Dives of one Diver that overlap; and, about one Dive (`other: null`), a Recording under 2 minutes that stayed above 3 m, at no Provider: offer deleting it (DELETE /dives/{id}) or keeping it. `status=answered` lists the pairs the User said are two dives and the Dives they said to keep, to ask again. Resolve one by merging (POST /dives/{id}/merge), answering (PUT /logbook-checks/answer), correcting a time, moving or deleting one of the Dives. Never merge unasked (docs/spec/clients.md).

rule.description: recording_beside_entry: a Dive without a Recording and one with a Recording at the same time, as an import would have attached them; overlapping_dives: two Dives of one Diver that overlap in time; entry_apart_from_recording: a Dive without a Recording and one with one on the same local day, not overlapping, with depth (0.2 m or 3 %) and duration (3 minutes) agreeing: probably one dive typed with another start (never `obvious`; show both local start times and their difference)

put.summary: Answer a logbook check: these two Dives are two dives, or keep this Dive (or take the answer back)
put.description: Two ids with `two_dives`: the answer holds until one of the two Dives changes its start; then the pair is asked about again. One id with `keep` (a check about one Dive): it holds until the Dive's duration or depth changes. `answer: null` takes either back. 404 dive_not_found for a Dive not in the User's logbooks, check_not_found when the Dives break no rule. 400 for an answer that doesn't fit the number of Dives.

post.summary: Merge this Dive and another of the same Diver into one (the same descent logged twice)
post.description: Send both versions (409 dive_changed). The Dive with a Recording is kept when only one has, else this one; the answer is the kept Dive: follow its `id`. It gets the other's Recordings, fills what it lacks from it (site, Participants, values; the other's notes are appended), and takes its link at each Provider where it has none. The other is deleted like any Dive (GET /dives/deleted, `mergedInto`) and can be restored, without what it gave away. Where both are at a Provider, the other's dive there stays unless `alsoAt` names the Provider: it is deleted there first, and a refusal (provider_* codes) merges nothing. 400 merge_not_possible for the same Dive or Dives of two Divers. ADR 0038.

version.description: Send it back to restore the Dive

anyOf.description: The Dive it was merged into (ADR 0038): clients say so and link there
The Dive it became in another Diver's logbook when it was moved while linked to a Provider (ADR 0038)
The Provider's own dive number

stillAt.description: Providers the dive is still at: clients remind the User and offer to delete it there (docs/spec/clients.md)

state.description: waiting: goes out at `dueAt`; held: needs the User; stopped: failed for good (Retry)

anyOf.description: Why it is held (sign_in, requirements, exists, removes_verification) or the problem code of why it stopped

dueAt.description: When it goes out, for a waiting entry

waiting.description: The Dive's entries in the queue of Waiting pushes: a delete at a Provider that goes out 5 minutes after deleting here (Undo cancels it), or one that is held or stopped, with its reason

post.summary: Bring a deleted Dive back with its Recordings (not to Providers: send it again from there)
post.description: Send the version from GET /dives/deleted (409 dive_changed). A site deleted meanwhile becomes the one it was merged into, or none.

diverId.description: The Diver whose logbook this Dive is in

version.description: Send it back with an edit; it changes with every change

anyOf.description: The Dive's place in its Diver's logbook plus the Diver's dives before it (ADR 0048): computed, never set; null for a Dive that doesn't count

items.description: A Dive value that can be overridden

overrides.description: Values the User set by hand

utcOffsetSource.description: Where the start's UTC offset came from (ADR 0030): device, position (the time zone where the dive was), nearby (the Diver's Dives within 7 days) or unknown (startsAt is the local wall-clock time kept as if UTC: show it in UTC without an offset). Clients say where it came from when it isn't the device (docs/spec/clients.md)

anyOf.description: The Provider whose logbook entry this Dive was made from (ADR 0030); with no recordings, its values are that entry's
The Dive site (ADR 0020)
The Dive site's water type (ADR 0025); null without a site, or when the site has none. Not editable on the Dive

computer.description: What the Primary recording's computer was set to

anyOf.description: Recorded vs true depth in percent: negative reads shallow, positive deep; null where a density is unknown
Set when the computer was set to other water than the site's: clients say so (docs/spec/clients.md)
Where the Device of the Primary recording placed the dive: its exit, else its entry. Private like the Dive

waterType.description: The computer's salinity setting, not the water of the Dive (that is the site's)

waterDensity.description: Density the computer computed depths with, kg/m³

tankVolumeL.description: With a tank pod: the size of the tank, litres

sacLpm.description: Gas consumption at the surface as a tank pod measured it, L/min

conservatism.description: The personal setting of the computer where its model has one (Suunto: -2 to +2)

extras.description: Source values without a word in our vocabulary, by source field name

anyOf.description: Water volume in litres
Oxygen and helium in percent
Not above the start pressure

fromPod.description: An import made it from a tank pod's data and it still has the pod's series: clients say so (docs/spec/clients.md)

channel.description: A tank pod's pressure channel of that Recording: tankPressure, further pods tankPressure:<n>

anyOf.description: The pressure series of one of the Dive's Recordings that measured this Cylinder

cylinders.description: The Dive's Cylinders in their order (ADR 0045)

amountKg.description: In kilograms; 0 as the only entry means no lead

anyOf.description: Where it was carried; null when not given

lead.description: The Lead the Dive was dived with, as placed entries in their order (ADR 0031); none means unknown

anyOf.description: The sum of the Lead entries; null when there are none (unknown), 0 for a Dive without lead
By how many kilograms it was too heavy or too light, where the User said
How the weighting felt on this Dive (ADR 0031); null when nothing was said

type.description: `none` is a dive without a suit

anyOf.description: For a wetsuit or a semidry suit

hood.description: Whether a hood was worn; null when not said

anyOf.description: Under a drysuit
The exposure suit (ADR 0031); null when unknown

litresPerMinute.description: Litres per minute at the surface, summed over all the Dive's Cylinders, with real gas

anyOf.description: The pressure drop per minute at the surface; only for a Dive with exactly one Cylinder
SAC on this dive, computed from its Cylinders, its average depth and its duration, never stored (ADR 0045)
Why a Dive with Cylinders has no SAC: shorter than 15 minutes, no average depth, or a Cylinder without both pressures and a volume

name.description: The Diver's name, as every User sees it

role.description: buddy: dived together; guide: led the dive; instructor: taught on it

participants.description: Buddies first, then guides and instructors (ADR 0028)

post.summary: Take a buddy's or a professional's code: the Diver that has its SSI account gets what the code says
post.description: Read the text first (POST /api/verification-codes/read) and show what it answers. The Diver that has the account is filled, whatever diverId says otherwise (409 diver_external_id_taken names it). When no Diver has it: diverId gives account and details to that Diver (409 diver_has_other_account when it has another SSI account), create makes a new external Diver named after the code (201), neither is 409 diver_choice_needed. A buddy code leaves a leader number that is there. 400 code_not_a_person for a centre's code.

get.summary: How much lead a Diver should carry in planned conditions: a starting point with a range and its reasons (ADR 0031)
get.description: From the Diver's own Dives with the same suit set-up, adjusted for the cylinder and the water, else a rule of thumb from their body weight. Only for a User who keeps the Diver's logbook; others get 404 `diver_not_found`, as for body weights. Never certain: the answer always carries `range`, `basis`, `adjustments`, `missing` and the `weightCheck`; `total` and `range` are null when there is no Dive with the suit and no body weight. Nothing is stored. 400 `suit_invalid` for a thickness on a suit that has none, or an undergarment under anything but a drysuit.

post.summary: What a Push run would do: counts per case, what is held back and why, every number it would set, the limits and the time. Stores nothing
post.description: It calls the Provider once (a read of its logbook) only where `numbers` is chosen and a number differs, to name the dives only there that hold a wanted number.

list.description: The logbook's list for the Connection's Diver, as GET /api/dives takes siteId, q and only

ids.description: Instead of list: these Dives. Ids that are none of the Diver's are counted as notFound

dives.description: Exactly one of list and ids

updates.description: Also update Dives changed since they were sent (replaces the Provider's values)

updatesRemovingVerification.description: Also update (or set the number of) Dives where that removes a verification at the Provider

numbers.description: Also set the number of Dives already there whose number differs (ADR 0048)

numbersRemovingVerification.description: Confirmed once for the run: set numbers where that can remove a verification at the Provider (ADR 0052). Not what updatesRemovingVerification is for

withHolders.description: With dives.ids: also the Dives here whose number at the Provider the named ones want, and so on, so that a taken number is freed by a run (ADR 0052)

number.description: Dives already there whose number differs and can be set, whether or not they are also updated

numberRemovingVerification.description: Of those, the ones that need updatesRemovingVerification as well

numberTaken.description: Of those, the ones that wait for a dive the run doesn't move

numberHeldAtProvider.description: Of those, the ones a dive only at the Provider holds the number of; known only when `numbers` is chosen (the logbook is read for it)

counts.description: What is there, whatever the choices say

numberNotChosen.description: Dives whose number differs and that a run with numbers would set

numberTaken.description: Number changes that wait for a dive the run doesn't move (a Dive here left out, or one with no number); set them from their own pages

numberHeldAtProvider.description: Number changes whose number a dive only at the Provider holds; import that dive (ADR 0052)

leftOut.description: What the run left out when it was planned, as counts

send.description: How many a start with these choices queues

withLeftOut.description: Dives to send that go without a Participant an advisory requirement leaves out

anyOf.description: site_external_id: the Dive site to give the ID; null: choose a site first

bySend.description: site_external_id: sending finds the site at the Provider or creates it there as a private site (the site has a position), so it does not stop a send; offering the pick stays

fixes.description: diver_mapping: ways to fix it. diver_external_id: set the Diver's account at source (PUT /api/divers/{id}/external-ids/{source}). list_entry: link or add an entry in the account's own list at the Provider (SSI: the buddy list)

items.description: A requirement this Dive doesn't meet, from Dive Hub's own data

dives.description: The first 100, oldest first

inScope.description: How many Dives the request names (those of the list, or the ids found), whatever happens to them

anyOf.description: The Dive's number here
Its number at the Provider now
The Dive that still holds `to`: this first step of a swap or cycle makes the number twice for one save

with.description: number: a save of its own; update: goes with the dive's update

numberPlan.description: Every number a start would set, in the order they go, so the User sees them before anything is sent (ADR 0052)

anyOf.description: The dive at the Provider that has the number (local time as it keeps it); a dive only there

heldAtProvider.description: Number changes held back by a dive only at the Provider, the first 100; lead to the import

dives.description: The Dives a start with these choices would queue, in the order they are sent: at most `limits.maxDives`

get.summary: Every Provider of this instance and what it offers: sign-in, kinds of data and operations, delivery, notices, limits
get.description: Clients render the Connections and each Dive's panels from this (docs/spec/clients.md). It changes only with the server.

name.description: Proper name, the same in every UI language

anyOf.description: What the login field asks for (password sign-in)

canKeepPassword.description: Offer "Keep me signed in": password sign-in, and this server can keep passwords (DIVEHUB_ENCRYPTION_KEY)

findBy.description: How find finds a record: by our reference, by a time window, near a position

delivery.description: confirmed: an ID comes back. handed_over: no ID, so no update, delete or link

type.description: site_external_id: the Dive site's External ID at source. diver_mapping: the Provider can tell who each Participant in roles is. A client that doesn't know the type shows description and that it can't be fixed there (docs/spec/clients.md)

severity.description: blocking: sending refuses while unmet. advisory: sent without it; the Push says what was left out

description.description: English; only for a client that doesn't know the type

source.description: site_external_id: a site Source. diver_mapping: the service whose account a Diver needs

anyOf.description: site_external_id: Users may type an ID (PUT /api/dive-sites/{id}/external-ids/{source})
site_external_id: what the bare ID looks like (a regular expression)
site_external_id: what may come before the ID as the Source shows it, e.g. "site:"
site_external_id: a send finds or creates the site at the Provider when the site has a position

items.description: What sending needs (ADR 0029)

readBackFields.description: Field names read-back differences are reported under; translate them

set.description: The operations on which a client sets the dive's number here; update goes with POST /api/dives/{id}/providers/{provider}/number

changeRemovesVerification.description: Changing the number of a dive already there can remove a verification it has: warn before

anyOf.description: ADR 0048: null when the Provider numbers by itself. Else a Connection can be set to number dives here as in Dive Hub (diveNumbers.follow)

findBy.description: How find finds a record: by our reference, by a time window, near a position

fields.description: Which way each value of a dive travels; absent: every value travels both ways as far as the Provider's operations allow (imported if it imports, sent if it exports); present: a value missing from the map is not imported

findBy.description: How find finds a record: by our reference, by a time window, near a position
How find finds a record: by our reference, by a time window, near a position

anyOf.description: find: the account's own list of people (SSI: the buddy list), GET /api/connections/{id}/buddies

findBy.description: How find finds a record: by our reference, by a time window, near a position

anyOf.description: find: the account's certification cards (SSI: get_ccards), POST /api/connections/{id}/certifications/import (ADR 0050)

notices.description: Things a client must say: shows_unconfirmed, the Provider shows dives sent this way as unconfirmed; presents_as_app, Dive Hub introduces itself to the Provider as its own app (ADR 0049)

pauseMs.description: Pause between two actions on one Connection; requests wait their turn
Pause between two Dives of a Push run

maxDives.description: The most Dives one Push run sends; start again for the rest

anyOf.description: ADR 0047; null: the Provider takes no Push runs
The shortest interval of a scheduled fetch of its dives, in minutes; null: no scheduled fetch. A Connection's `offers.fetchEvery` is already narrowed by it

get.summary: The User's Connections to Providers (one per Diver and Provider at most)

diverId.description: The Diver whose account at the Provider this is

accountId.description: The account at the Provider (SSI: user master ID)

accountLabel.description: What the User recognises the account by (SSI: the e-mail)

keepSignedIn.description: The password is kept (sealed); otherwise only the Provider's access, which can expire

state.description: needs_sign_in: the Provider no longer accepts the sign-in; sign in again

follow.description: Dives are numbered here as in Dive Hub (off until the User turns it on; it sends nothing by itself)

anyOf.description: ADR 0048; null when the Provider declares no numbers

patch.summary: Change what importing the account's dives may do, the matching window, the choice per dive computer (ADR 0030), whether dives are numbered at the Provider as in Dive Hub (ADR 0048), and what the Connection does by itself (ADR 0056)
patch.description: diveNumbers.follow turns on numbering at the Provider; it sends nothing by itself. 400 provider_unsupported at a Provider that declares no numbers. sendChanges, sendNewDives and deleteAtProvider turn on sending, sending new Dives and deleting by itself; fetchEveryMinutes (60, 360, 1440, or null for off) the scheduled fetch. Turning one on queues nothing that changed before. Only what `offers` of the Connection lists: 400 provider_unsupported otherwise (turning off is always allowed), 400 fetch_interval_too_short for an interval below the minimum of the Provider. At least one property.

choice.description: recordings: its dives become Recordings, like a file's; entries: only logbook entries that fill Dives here

computers.description: Per dive computer found at the Provider (its key from the preview): how its dives are used

get.summary: What waits for the choice of the User ("Needs your decision"), per Connection; no call to a Provider
get.description: A Conflict (kind conflict) is a field changed on both sides, differently, found while sending or fetching a Dive. One entry per Dive and Provider, with both values of each field. The User chooses per field, the Dive Hub value preselected; the choice goes to POST /api/dives/{id}/providers/{provider}/decision with `conflicts` (or sends the Dive from its page with `conflicts`). A Dive the Provider already has a dive for (kind exists) waits for "Link to it" or "Create a new one": the same route with `onExisting`. A choice queues the Dive, due now: an exists entry leaves the list, a conflict entry stays with queued true until the send settles. An entry whose Dive is deleted, or whose remote dive is no longer the current one of the Dive, is not listed.

kind.description: conflict: fields changed on both sides, the User chooses per field. exists: the Provider already has a dive at the Dive's time and the send waits (fields is empty): "<Provider> already has a dive at this time" with "Link to it" and "Create a new one"

remoteId.description: conflict: the remote dive the Conflict is about. exists: the dive at the Provider

field.description: The field the two sides differ on

anyOf.description: O₂ and He as percent

site: its name; buddies: the names of Divers here (people Dive Hub doesn't know are left out); startsAt: local "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"; cylinder: the tank typed at the Provider, or the Dive's only Cylinder in the same values (null: none); lead: the weight typed at the Provider, or the total of the Dive's Lead, in kg (null: none)

fields.description: `hub` is the Dive's value now, `provider` the Provider's as the run found it; a field whose two values became equal is left out. An entry with no field left is not listed (nor counted in the Connection's or a run's conflicts)

post.summary: The User's decision for a Dive at a Provider: it is queued as a send, due now, with this choice (ADR 0056)
post.description: From "Needs your decision", by the entry's kind. `exists` (the Provider already has a dive at the Dive's time): `onExisting` link ties the Dive to that dive and updates it, create makes a second dive there. `conflict` (a field changed on both sides): `conflicts` per field, hub sends the Dive's value over the Provider's, provider takes the Provider's value into the Dive here (a Revision of the User's) and leaves that field as it is there; the other fields go out as usual. It sends nothing at once: the worker sends, one Dive after another, paced for the Provider (the Dive's page keeps POST /api/dives/{id}/providers/{provider}, which sends at once). At least one property; 404 dive_not_found, 404 connection_not_found as for Retry.

post.summary: Send the Dive to the Provider: updates its remote dive, or creates one
post.description: Before creating, a dive at about the same time already at the Provider is answered with outcome exists and nothing is sent; send again with onExisting link (tie the Dive to it) or create (a second dive). Mind the Provider's notices. An update is three-way (ADR 0056): what changed only at the Provider is taken into the Dive first (taken), a value removed here is removed there, and a field changed on both sides is a Conflict: outcome conflicts, nothing sent. Send again with conflicts, a choice per field (hub preselected).

conflicts.description: Per Conflict: hub sends the Dive's value, provider takes the Provider's. A field that is no Conflict any more is ignored

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: A Provider's id (GET /api/providers); others answer provider_unsupported

outcome.description: exists: nothing was sent; a dive at the same time is there. Send again with onExisting link or create. conflicts: nothing was sent; list the fields with both values and send again with conflicts

anyOf.description: Local time as the Provider keeps it, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"
A dive already at the Provider at about the same time

field.description: The field the two sides differ on

anyOf.description: O₂ and He as percent

site: its name; buddies: the names of Divers here (people Dive Hub doesn't know are left out); startsAt: local "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"; cylinder: the tank typed at the Provider, or the Dive's only Cylinder in the same values (null: none); lead: the weight typed at the Provider, or the total of the Dive's Lead, in kg (null: none)
O₂ and He as percent

site: its name; buddies: the names of Divers here (people Dive Hub doesn't know are left out); startsAt: local "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"; cylinder: the tank typed at the Provider, or the Dive's only Cylinder in the same values (null: none); lead: the weight typed at the Provider, or the total of the Dive's Lead, in kg (null: none)
With outcome conflicts: the fields changed on both sides
With outcome updated: the fields taken from the Provider into the Dive first
With outcome updated: the fields left as the Provider has them

name.description: The entry name as the Provider answered it

added.description: Entries the send made in the list of people at the Provider

knownAs.description: Entries whose name at the Provider differs from the Diver name: whom the Provider knows the account as

anyOf.description: What the send did to the list of people at the Provider; null when it added nothing and nothing is known by another name

deletesItself.description: The Dive's Connection deletes at the Provider by itself (5 minutes after the Dive is deleted here; Undo cancels it): don't ask about deleting the copy there, and don't send `alsoAt` for it (docs/spec/clients.md)

state.description: waiting: goes out at `dueAt`; held: needs the User; stopped: failed for good (Retry)

anyOf.description: Why it is held (sign_in, requirements, exists, removes_verification) or the problem code of why it stopped

dueAt.description: When it goes out, for a waiting entry

waiting.description: The Dive's entry in the queue of Waiting pushes for this Provider (ADR 0056); null when none

anyOf.description: The Connection of the Dive's Diver; null when that Diver is not connected to this Provider
The Dive site
site_external_id: the Dive site to give the ID; null: choose a site first

bySend.description: site_external_id: sending finds the site at the Provider or creates it there as a private site (the site has a position), so it does not stop a send; offering the pick stays

fixes.description: diver_mapping: ways to fix it. diver_external_id: set the Diver's account at source (PUT /api/divers/{id}/external-ids/{source}). list_entry: link or add an entry in the account's own list at the Provider (SSI: the buddy list)

items.description: A requirement this Dive doesn't meet, from Dive Hub's own data

unmet.description: What the Provider's requirements need and the Dive lacks; never asks the Provider

upToDate.description: false: the Dive changed since it was sent (outdated), or it was linked and never sent

updateRemovesVerification.description: An update now would remove the dive centre's verification of the dive at the Provider (SSI: it changes the start time there, or the dive was linked and never sent, so the start time there isn't known). Say so before sending (docs/spec/clients.md, ADR 0043)

differs.description: The Provider's number (remoteNumber) is another. Not "changed since sent": don't offer an update for it

canSet.description: The Provider sets numbers on an update: offer "Set number" (POST /api/dives/{id}/providers/{provider}/number)

removesVerification.description: Setting it can remove a verification the dive has there: warn before

anyOf.description: ADR 0048; null when the Connection doesn't follow, the Provider declares no numbers or the Dive has no number
The remote dive this Dive has now; null when none (never sent, deleted)

put.summary: Set or clear a Dive site's ID at the Connection's Provider: picked from its sites or typed, after asking the Provider
put.description: The Provider is asked about the ID first. One it calls public is stored public (with a Revision); the account's own private one is stored private to the Connection's account; an ID it has no site for (also another account's private site) is 422 provider_site_unknown and nothing is stored. When it does not say or cannot be asked, the ID is stored private, never public. null clears the account's private ID of the site only (the public ID is cleared with PUT /api/dive-sites/{id}/external-ids/{source}). 409 external_id_taken when another site has the ID.

anyOf.description: As the User typed or picked it; null clears the private ID
The bare ID stored; null after a clear

post.summary: Set the number of the Dive's remote dive to the Dive's own number, and change nothing else there (ADR 0048)
post.description: Makes a Push with the action number. The Dive's state stays what it was: one changed since it was sent still is. 409 provider_numbers_off (the Connection doesn't follow), provider_number_nothing_to_set (no number, or the Provider has it already: fetch the status again), provider_number_taken (another dive there has the number; existing names it, diveId the Dive here if known: set that one first), and the codes a send has.
